item.title: Cloud Init With ConfigDrive
item.description: cloud-init使用OpenStack的ConfigDrive & userdata的方法 镜像中配置cloud-init 安装cloud-init dnf install -y cloud-init 配置cloud-init 配置文件：/etc/cloud/cloud.cfg disable_root: false preserve_hostname: true manage_etc_hosts: false datasource_list: [ ConfigDrive, NoCloud, None ] users: - default # 保留默认module设置 cloud_init_modules: cloud_config_modules: cloud_final_modules: - power-state-change # 默认系统设置 system_info: default_user: name: root lock_passwd: false distro: 保持发行版默认值 # system_info其他参数可保留 镜像console配置 grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args="console=ttyS0,115200n8" grubby --info=DEFAULT | grep args # 验证 镜像cloud-init源码更新 发行版ID加入cloud-init KNOWN_DISTROS列表 # /usr/lib/python3.6/site-packages/cloudinit/net/sysconfig.py KNOWN_DISTROS = [ 'bclinux', 'openeuler' ] userdata文件配置 根据实际情况编写内容 #cloud-config power_state: mode: poweroff delay: +1 timeout: 60 write_files: - path: /usr/local/bin/purge-cloudinit.
